73471.subject: Hausa
73471.question_text: Da malalaci da mayaudari duk malalaciya ce uwarsu. Kalmomin sifa nawa ne a cikin wannan jimla?
73471.explanation: How many adjectives are in the sentence "Da malalaci da mayaudari duk malalaciya ce uwarsu"? Answer: Uku (There are three adjectives i the sentence: malalaci, mayaudari, and malalaciya. Biyu means two, Hudu means four, Biyar means five, and Shida means six)
